integrity: Proof is given in RESULT.md; numerical checker is supplementary and uses NumPy. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted point--line incidence graph metrics of existing finite affine planes, order at least two.
Other resolvable designs and all weighted variants are not covered.
Finite numerical checks do not prove the universal theorem.
Independent historical-priority and proof validation have not been performed.
title: Exact negative type of finite affine-plane incidence metrics
